long_biography.plain_text:
At twenty-three, Jorma Lillbacka opened a subcontract machine shop in Alahärmä. Customer visits exposed a practical bottleneck: crimping hose fittings took too much time, and no suitable machine was available. His decision to build one produced the Finn-Power crimper line. When his own production later needed sheet-metal parts, he developed punching machinery and automation instead of buying it in.

That habit of solving missing infrastructure shaped the wider group. Lillbacka created transport operations to move machinery internationally, while PowerPark grew from a karting track into an amusement and hospitality complex. In later years he remained a source of ideas while his sons took on execution, keeping the enterprise family-owned.

At twenty-three, Jorma Lillbacka opened a subcontract machine shop in Alahärmä. When his own production later needed sheet-metal parts, he developed punching machinery and automation instead of buying it in.

That habit of solving missing infrastructure shaped the wider group. Lillbacka created transport operations to move machinery internationally, while PowerPark grew from a karting track into an amusement and hospitality complex. In later years he remained a source of ideas while his sons took on execution, keeping the enterprise family-owned.
